verdict.rationale: Edge0 has a CLI that loads models (`edge0 serve edge0-35b`) and exposes flags like `--max-new`, `--no-prerouter` and `--no-lora`. None of these set GPU offload or context length: `--max-new` only caps generation length, and SSD expert offload is automatic rather than user-tunable. CUDA is listed only as a reserved backend slot, so the story's specific settings are unevidenced.
